name: Engeki Taiketsu
source:
What theater program has the homeroom teacher cooked up to match up against Satsuki's class, who were last year's winners?

Which class will be left standing this year?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ270959.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
去年夺冠的Satsuki所在班级，今年将迎来怎样的对手？班主任又为对方准备了什么演出？

今年，究竟哪个班能笑到最后？

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ270959.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
